faqText: Find quick answers to common questions about our services, bookings and support.

faqs.q: How can I book a puja or religious ceremony?
faqs.a: Open the service you need on our Services page and use its booking button, or send us a message with the form above. Our team will confirm the details, date and sankalp with you.

faqs.q: Can I book services for a specific date and time?
faqs.a: Yes. Mention your preferred date and time when you book or write to us. We will confirm availability, or suggest the nearest auspicious muhurat if needed.

faqs.q: Do you provide services outside India?
faqs.a: Yes. Devotees living anywhere in the world can book with us. Pujas are performed in India in your name and gotra, and many services can be joined through a live video call.

faqs.q: How can I contribute to your social welfare initiatives?
faqs.a: Visit our Donate page to contribute, or choose “Donation & Welfare” in the form above and tell us how you would like to help, including seva and volunteering.
